notes: Ghosts cannot hurt the cats — they block, and a blocked cat hisses (loudly: rats freeze, spiders retreat). The litter box is in the NW corner. What is beside it is not an objective.

objectives.detail: Defeat the Alpha Rat and its den pack at the centre of the box maze.
objectives.title: Clear the labyrinth heart

objectives.detail: A ball, a mouse toy and a feather, hidden in the maze. One is behind a gap only a small cat fits through.
objectives.title: Find the 3 lost toys

objectives.detail: Reach the labyrinth heart without hissing at a ghost.
objectives.title: Unspooked
